text:
marta (community): Quick update: we shipped `redwoodctl-contrib` v0.9.0 and a short maintainer process change + community open-hours next week. Release notes + downloads: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwoodctl-contrib/releases/tag/v0.9.0 :rocket:

alex (open-source): Release looks great  what's new in 0.9.0?

marta (community): Highlights: contributor CLI subcommands for repo scaffolding, a `contrib audit` check that flags missing license headers, and faster template generation. Full changelog: https://rwd.co/rwc-contrib-0-9-0

sam (maintainer): Important for maintainers: we switched to a two-week rotation (instead of 1-week) for peripheral repos to cut churn. Updated MAINTAINERS doc is live. Read before opting in.

min (localization): Heads-up: CLI now emits a PO-friendly export when `--i18n` is passed. That should make localized README contributions easier.

alex (open-source): Any breaking changes?

marta (community): No breaking changes. A few opt-in flags changed names (`--init-template` -> `--scaffold`). See migration note in the release page.

dev-bot: Release published: redwoodctl-contrib v0.9.0 by @alex (open-source). CI: all checks passed.

sam (maintainer): Also posted a short handover checklist in the MAINTAINERS doc and a tiny template for handoffs. I'm running a 30-min office hour Tuesday 15:00 UTC for anyone who wants a walkthrough.

min (localization): We'll run a parallel localization office hour Wednesday 03:00 UTC for APAC contributors; will be recorded.

marta (community): Community open-hours + AMA scheduled: Tue 15:00 UTC & Wed 03:00 UTC. Add yourself to the sign-up sheet if you want to demo the CLI or discuss maintainer topics: https://rwd.co/community-office-hours.

alex (open-source): Tagging maintainers: please test the `contrib audit` on your repos and file issues for false positives.

marta (community): Incentives: first 10 accepted community PRs that add localization or fix audit issues get a sticker + priority review token.

sam (maintainer): I'll create `good-first-cli` and `i18n-ready` labels.

marta (community): Final: maintainers process update is effective immediately. CLI v0.9.0 is the recommended tooling baseline; open issues/PRs on the release board. Thanks folks! :sparkles:
